subject: Candidate: power outage en route — request to convert to recorded code walkthrough
messages:
From: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@novapulse.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Running into a power outage on my commute — interview at 9:00

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

I’m on my way back from an early appointment but there’s a city-wide outage affecting my neighborhood and the transit lines. I’m worried I won’t make the 9:00 AM code walkthrough with Jordan.

Options that work for me if it helps:
- I can record a 25–30 minute screen + voice walkthrough of the coding exercise now and send the file (MP4).
- I’m available to join a 30-minute audio-only call at 11:00 AM if power returns.
- If neither works, I can reschedule to tomorrow morning (preferred window 9–11 PT).

I know this is last-minute — sorry for the disruption. I can upload the recording to Google Drive and share the link, or email the file directly.

Thanks for understanding,
Alex Lopez
Senior Backend Engineer (candidate)
Novapulse

Attachment: none (will send recording if we go that route)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Running into a power outage on my commute — interview at 9:00

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and I’m sorry you’re dealing with that. Couple of options from our side so we can keep things moving: 

1) Recorded code walkthrough: Please record your screen + voice doing the exercise and send the file (MP4) or a Drive link. Jordan and I will review and follow up with any clarifying questions asynchronously; we can schedule a short live Q&A if needed.

2) Quick backup interview: Jordan is available for a 25-minute audio-only call between 10:30–11:30 PT if power comes back earlier. If you can join that, let me know the preferred time.

3) Reschedule: If neither of those work, we can move the interview to tomorrow morning 9–11 PT — tell us your window and we’ll lock something in.

If you go with a recording, please include: brief intro (name, role you’re interviewing for), the problem file you worked on, and a short note on trade-offs at the end. 

We can cover candidate expenses if this ends up turning into a travel issue — ping me receipts and I’ll route to People Ops.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

---
Rachel Kim
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: 2028-11-03T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Running into a power outage on my commute — interview at 9:00

Thanks Rachel / Alex — I’m fine accepting a recorded walkthrough in place of the live session today. If Alex sends the MP4 / Drive link, I’ll watch it and leave time-stamped comments. If we have follow-ups, we can hop on a 15–20 minute sync later today (11:30–12:00 PT) or tomorrow morning.

For reviewers: please include the problem prompt and the test harness or input you used so we can run behavior checks locally. Also okay to compress the video if file size is large.

— Jordan
Lead SWE, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ExampleCandidateVideoLink

Thanks for the flexibility — sorry again for the scramble.
